explainer.summary: WETH9 is an ERC20-compatible wrapper for Ether with public name "Wrapped Ether", symbol "WETH" and 18 decimals. It accepts ETH via the fallback or explicit deposit, credits balanceOf[msg.sender], and allows withdrawal by burning tokens and sending ETH. All state changes and transfers are implemented directly in the single contract with no external calls except the final transfer in withdraw.

key_functions.name: deposit
key_functions.what: payable function that adds msg.value to balanceOf[msg.sender] and emits Deposit

key_functions.name: withdraw
key_functions.what: requires balanceOf[msg.sender] >= wad, subtracts wad, performs msg.sender.transfer(wad) and emits Withdrawal

key_functions.name: totalSupply
key_functions.what: view function returning this.balance

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: sets allowance[msg.sender][guy] = wad, emits Approval and returns true

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: calls transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad)

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: checks balanceOf[src] >= wad, deducts from allowance[src][msg.sender] unless src==msg.sender or allowance==uint(-1), updates balances and emits Transfer

key_functions.name: fallback
key_functions.what: payable function that unconditionally calls deposit()

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; the contract contains no owner, proxy, or selfdestruct logic and is immutable after deployment.
user_risks: Allowance value of uint(-1) is treated as infinite and never decremented
No reentrancy guard on withdraw beyond checks-effects-interactions pattern
totalSupply reflects contract ETH balance which can be affected by direct sends
integration_tips: Use deposit() or plain ETH transfer to mint WETH
Call withdraw(uint) to redeem ETH; ensure sufficient gas for the internal transfer
Standard ERC20 approval and transferFrom patterns apply, including the infinite-allowance optimization

explainer.summary: TetherToken.sol implements an ERC20 token with owner-controlled pausing, blacklisting, fee collection on transfers, minting/redeeming, and a deprecation flag that forwards calls to an upgraded contract. The contract inherits Pausable, StandardToken, and BlackList, with all privileged actions restricted by onlyOwner and whenNotPaused modifiers. Fee parameters are capped at 20 basis points and 50 units, and blacklisted addresses can have funds destroyed.

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: Transfers tokens after checking blacklist and pause state; deducts optional fee sent to owner and forwards to upgraded contract if deprecated.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Transfers from allowance after blacklist/pause checks; applies fee logic and forwards if deprecated.

key_functions.name: issue
key_functions.what: Only owner: increases _totalSupply and owner balance by the given amount.

key_functions.name: redeem
key_functions.what: Only owner: decreases _totalSupply and owner balance by the given amount.

key_functions.name: addBlackList
key_functions.what: Only owner: marks an address as blacklisted.

key_functions.name: destroyBlackFunds
key_functions.what: Only owner: zeros a blacklisted address balance and reduces _totalSupply.

key_functions.name: deprecate
key_functions.what: Only owner: sets deprecated=true and records the upgradedAddress for forwarding.

key_functions.name: setParams
key_functions.what: Only owner: updates basisPointsRate and maximumFee within hardcoded limits.

key_functions.name: pause
key_functions.what: Only owner: sets paused=true when not already paused.

admin_powers: deprecate contract and point to upgradedAddress
explainer.upgradeability: Boolean deprecated flag plus upgradedAddress; when true, transfer/transferFrom/approve/balanceOf/allowance/totalSupply forward to UpgradedStandardToken at that address via *ByLegacy methods.
user_risks: Owner can pause all transfers
Owner can blacklist any address and destroy its funds
Owner can mint arbitrary new tokens via issue()
Small transfer fees may be collected to owner when basisPointsRate > 0
integration_tips: Check !deprecated and !paused before relying on local state
Use balanceOf and totalSupply which already handle deprecation forwarding
Approve calls must satisfy the non-zero allowance race-condition guard in the code

explainer.summary: FiatTokenV2_2 extends FiatTokenV2_1 and adds initializeV2_2 to migrate deprecated blacklists while updating the token symbol and setting _initializedVersion to 3. It overrides blacklist/balance storage in balanceAndBlacklistStates using the high bit for blacklist state, updates _domainSeparator to version "2", and exposes signature-based permit/authorization functions that delegate to internal _permit/_transferWithAuthorization etc. All external mutators enforce whenNotPaused and notBlacklisted checks from parent contracts.

key_functions.name: initializeV2_2
key_functions.what: Requires _initializedVersion==2, sets symbol=newSymbol, migrates accountsToBlacklist from _deprecatedBlacklisted into _blacklist, blacklists address(this), then sets _initializedVersion=3.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: External whenNotPaused wrapper calling _permit with bytes signature (or v,r,s overload from V2).

key_functions.name: transferWithAuthorization
key_functions.what: External whenNotPaused notBlacklisted wrapper calling _transferWithAuthorization with bytes signature.

key_functions.name: receiveWithAuthorization
key_functions.what: External whenNotPaused notBlacklisted wrapper calling _receiveWithAuthorization; enforces to==msg.sender.

key_functions.name: cancelAuthorization
key_functions.what: External whenNotPaused wrapper calling _cancelAuthorization with bytes signature.

key_functions.name: _setBlacklistState
key_functions.what: Internal override that ORs (1<<255) into balanceAndBlacklistStates or resets to _balanceOf.

key_functions.name: _setBalance
key_functions.what: Internal override that requires balance<=(1<<255)-1 and not blacklisted, then stores in balanceAndBlacklistStates.

key_functions.name: _isBlacklisted
key_functions.what: Internal view override returning (balanceAndBlacklistStates[_account]>>255)==1.

key_functions.name: _balanceOf
key_functions.what: Internal view override returning balanceAndBlacklistStates[_account] & ((1<<255)-1).

admin_powers: initializeV2_2 (one-time migration of blacklist and symbol)
explainer.upgradeability: Implementation contract deployed at 0x43506849D7C04F9138D1A2050bbF3A0c054402dd; initializeV2_2 must be called exactly once after proxy upgrade from V2_1 to reach version 3.
user_risks: Blacklisted accounts cannot transfer or have balances updated
permit/authorization signatures are invalidated only after use or deadline; front-running possible on receiveWithAuthorization if to != caller
Balances cannot exceed (2^255-1)
All state-changing calls revert when paused
integration_tips: Use the bytes-signature permit/authorization overloads for EOA wallets
Call initializeV2_2 with the full list of accounts that were blacklisted under the deprecated mapping
Query _balanceOf/_isBlacklisted rather than direct storage reads
Domain separator uses name, "2", and current chainId via assembly chainid()

explainer.summary: Dai is an ERC20 token contract with authorization controls via wards, mint/burn restricted to authorized callers, and EIP-712 permit support for gasless approvals. It inherits LibNote for event logging on state-changing calls and implements standard transfer/approve logic plus alias functions. The contract is deployed as a non-upgradeable implementation with no proxy or delegatecall patterns present in the source.

key_functions.name: rely
key_functions.what: Grants ward status to an address, callable only by existing wards and emitting via note modifier.

key_functions.name: deny
key_functions.what: Revokes ward status from an address, callable only by existing wards and emitting via note modifier.

key_functions.name: mint
key_functions.what: Increases balance and totalSupply for a user, restricted to authorized wards.

key_functions.name: burn
key_functions.what: Decreases balance and totalSupply, with allowance checks unless infinite approval.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens between addresses, deducting allowance unless infinite or self-call.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowance for a spender and emits Approval event.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Sets allowance via EIP-712 signature, validating nonce, expiry, and holder.

key_functions.name: push
key_functions.what: Alias calling transferFrom from msg.sender to usr.

key_functions.name: pull
key_functions.what: Alias calling transferFrom from usr to msg.sender.

key_functions.name: move
key_functions.what: Alias calling transferFrom between src and dst.

explainer.upgradeability: None; contract contains no proxy, delegatecall, or upgrade logic.
user_risks: Authorized wards can mint arbitrary supply
permit allows allowance changes via signature if nonce/expiry valid
integration_tips: Check wards[msg.sender] before expecting mint/burn access
Use infinite allowance (-1) to skip per-transfer allowance deductions
Call permit with correct DOMAIN_SEPARATOR derived from chainId and contract address

explainer.summary: UniswapV2Factory (constructor takes _feeToSetter) deploys UniswapV2Pair instances via create2 in createPair, stores them in getPair and allPairs, and exposes feeTo/feeToSetter for protocol fee routing. All pair logic (mint/burn/swap) lives in the separate UniswapV2Pair contract initialized once by the factory; no other contracts or upgrade paths exist in the source. FeeToSetter alone can call setFeeTo and setFeeToSetter.

key_functions.name: createPair
key_functions.what: validates tokens, deploys UniswapV2Pair via create2 with salt=keccak256(token0,token1), calls initialize, records in getPair/allPairs and emits PairCreated

key_functions.name: setFeeTo
key_functions.what: sets feeTo address; only callable by feeToSetter

key_functions.name: setFeeToSetter
key_functions.what: sets new feeToSetter; only callable by current feeToSetter

key_functions.name: getPair
key_functions.what: mapping(token0=>token1=>pair) public view returning the pair address

key_functions.name: allPairs
key_functions.what: array of all created pair addresses; allPairsLength returns its length

key_functions.name: feeTo
key_functions.what: public address that receives protocol fees when feeTo != address(0)

key_functions.name: feeToSetter
key_functions.what: public address authorized to change feeTo and feeToSetter

admin_powers: feeToSetter can call setFeeTo to redirect protocol fees
feeToSetter can call setFeeToSetter to transfer admin rights
explainer.upgradeability: none: constructor sets immutable feeToSetter; no proxy, delegatecall, or selfdestruct patterns present
user_risks: feeToSetter is a single point of control that can redirect all future protocol fees
createPair reverts on identical addresses, zero address, or existing pair
pair creation uses create2 so address is deterministic but still requires on-chain deployment
integration_tips: call createPair only from contracts that have performed safety checks on tokenA/tokenB
read getPair[token0][token1] before calling createPair to avoid revert on PAIR_EXISTS
monitor PairCreated events to discover new pairs instead of polling allPairs

explainer.summary: UniswapV2Router02 implements IUniswapV2Router02 to route liquidity additions/removals and token/ETH swaps through Uniswap V2 pairs created by the factory. It stores immutable factory and WETH addresses set in the constructor, enforces deadlines with the ensure modifier, and delegates pair operations and calculations to UniswapV2Library and IUniswapV2Pair. The contract contains no owner, fee, or administrative functions.

key_functions.name: addLiquidity
key_functions.what: calls _addLiquidity then transfers tokens to the pair and mints liquidity to 'to'

key_functions.name: addLiquidityETH
key_functions.what: wraps ETH to WETH, adds liquidity with the token, mints LP tokens, and refunds excess ETH

key_functions.name: removeLiquidity
key_functions.what: transfers LP tokens to the pair, burns them, and returns sorted token amounts meeting minimums

key_functions.name: swapExactTokensForTokens
key_functions.what: computes amounts via getAmountsOut, transfers input to first pair, then calls _swap

key_functions.name: swapExactETHForTokens
key_functions.what: wraps msg.value to WETH, requires path[0]==WETH, then executes _swap

key_functions.name: _swap
key_functions.what: iterates the path, calculates output amounts, and calls pair.swap for each hop

key_functions.name: swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
key_functions.what: transfers input then uses _swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens and checks output balance delta

key_functions.name: quote
key_functions.what: delegates to UniswapV2Library.quote for price calculations

key_functions.name: getAmountsOut
key_functions.what: delegates to UniswapV2Library.getAmountsOut using the stored factory

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; factory and WETH are immutable and set only in the constructor.
user_risks: Transactions revert if deadline < block.timestamp via ensure modifier
Swaps and liquidity operations can fail on insufficient output/input amounts
Fee-on-transfer tokens require the SupportingFeeOnTransfer variants to avoid under-delivery
integration_tips: Always pass a deadline >= block.timestamp
Pre-approve the router for token transfers before calling swap or addLiquidity
Use the SupportingFeeOnTransfer functions when interacting with fee-on-transfer tokens
Check return values of getAmountsOut/getAmountsIn to set realistic min/max bounds

explainer.summary: SwapRouter is a stateless contract for executing exact-input and exact-output swaps (single-hop or multi-hop) against Uniswap V3 pools via the uniswapV3SwapCallback mechanism. It inherits PeripheryImmutableState (factory + WETH9 set at construction), PeripheryValidation (deadline checks), PeripheryPaymentsWithFee, Multicall, and SelfPermit; all swap logic lives in exactInputInternal / exactOutputInternal and the four public entrypoints. No owner or privileged roles exist in the provided source.

key_functions.name: exactInputSingle
key_functions.what: Executes a single-pool exact-input swap with amountOutMinimum and optional sqrtPriceLimitX96, guarded by checkDeadline.

key_functions.name: exactInput
key_functions.what: Walks a multi-pool path performing successive exactInputInternal calls, updating payer and path until the final recipient receives the output.

key_functions.name: exactOutputSingle
key_functions.what: Executes a single-pool exact-output swap, enforces amountInMaximum, and resets amountInCached.

key_functions.name: exactOutput
key_functions.what: Performs exact-output swaps along a reversed path, reading the final amountIn from the transient amountInCached variable.

key_functions.name: uniswapV3SwapCallback
key_functions.what: Validates the pool callback, decodes SwapCallbackData, pays the required tokenIn (or continues the next hop for exact-output), and handles amountInCached for multi-hop exact-output.

key_functions.name: multicall
key_functions.what: Delegate-calls an array of encoded calls in one transaction, reverting with the inner revert string on failure.

key_functions.name: selfPermit
key_functions.what: Calls ERC20Permit.permit on a token so an EOA can approve the router inside a multicall.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; constructor sets immutable factory and WETH9, and no proxy or owner-controlled upgrade logic is present.
user_risks: Transactions revert after deadline via checkDeadline modifier.
Slippage protection only via amountOutMinimum / amountInMaximum parameters supplied by caller.
Intermediate hops custody tokens at the router address when path.hasMultiplePools().
integration_tips: Batch permit + swap + unwrapWETH9 via multicall to avoid separate approvals.
Set recipient to address(0) inside internal calls to custody intermediate outputs at the router.
Use exactInput / exactOutput with a bytes path built from Path library helpers for multi-hop routes.

explainer.summary: Permit2 (src/Permit2.sol) is a non-upgradeable contract that inherits SignatureTransfer and AllowanceTransfer to support both signature-based token transfers and stored-allowance transfers. It uses EIP-712 domain separation with chain-id caching for replay protection and requires users to approve the Permit2 contract on ERC20 tokens before any transfer. All logic for permits, nonces, expirations, and transfers is implemented in the inherited contracts and libraries shown in the source.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets amount and expiration for a spender on a token via the allowance mapping.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Verifies EIP-712 signature and updates approval for a single or batch PermitSingle/PermitBatch.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Transfers tokens using stored allowances, checking expiration and decrementing amount.

key_functions.name: lockdown
key_functions.what: Revokes allowances by setting amount to zero for listed token-spender pairs.

key_functions.name: invalidateNonces
key_functions.what: Advances the nonce stored in PackedAllowance for a token-spender pair.

key_functions.name: permitTransferFrom
key_functions.what: Verifies signature and executes a single or batch token transfer using unordered nonces.

key_functions.name: permitWitnessTransferFrom
key_functions.what: Same as permitTransferFrom but includes an additional witness hash for extra data.

key_functions.name: invalidateUnorderedNonces
key_functions.what: Marks bits in the nonceBitmap to invalidate specific unordered nonces.

key_functions.name: DOMAIN_SEPARATOR
key_functions.what: Returns the current EIP-712 domain separator, recomputing if chainId changed.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; the contract contains only immutable state and no proxy or owner-controlled upgrade logic.
user_risks: Signatures expire after the declared sigDeadline or deadline; late submission reverts with SignatureExpired.
Nonces must be exactly the current value or the bit must be unset; reuse or incorrect nonce reverts with InvalidNonce.
Allowances can be reduced or zeroed by the owner via lockdown or by transferFrom consumption.
Contract signatures are validated only via IERC1271.isValidSignature; incorrect magic value reverts.
integration_tips: Call ERC20.approve(Permit2, amount) before using any transfer or permit function.
Use DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() when constructing EIP-712 signatures off-chain.
Batch permits and transfers reduce gas when handling multiple tokens in one transaction.
Witness variants allow attaching extra data to the signed hash without changing the core permit struct.

explainer.summary: The Uni contract implements the UNI governance token as an EIP-20 compatible token with 1e9 total supply, uint96 balances, and delegation checkpoints for voting power. Minting is restricted to a single minter address that can only mint up to 2% of supply once per year after the initial mintingAllowedAfter timestamp. It also provides EIP-2612 permit and delegation-by-signature functionality using EIP-712.

key_functions.name: mint
key_functions.what: Allows the minter to create new tokens up to the mintCap after mintingAllowedAfter, updating totalSupply and delegating votes.

key_functions.name: setMinter
key_functions.what: Allows the current minter to transfer minting rights to a new address.

key_functions.name: delegate
key_functions.what: Sets the delegatee that will receive the caller's voting power from balances.

key_functions.name: delegateBySig
key_functions.what: Delegates votes via EIP-712 signature, incrementing nonce and checking expiry.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Sets allowance via EIP-712 signature with deadline, supporting infinite approval as uint96(-1).

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: Moves tokens and adjusts delegate vote balances using _transferTokens.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens after checking allowance (unless infinite), then calls _transferTokens.

key_functions.name: getPriorVotes
key_functions.what: Returns the vote balance for an account at a specific past blockNumber using binary search over checkpoints.

key_functions.name: getCurrentVotes
key_functions.what: Returns the latest checkpoint votes for an account or zero if none exist.

admin_powers: minter can call mint to increase totalSupply subject to time and percentage caps
minter can call setMinter to change the minter address
explainer.upgradeability: None; the contract has no proxy, owner, or upgrade mechanism in the source.
user_risks: A compromised minter can mint up to 2% of supply once per year
Approvals use uint96 storage so values above 2^96-1 are impossible
Delegation moves voting power separately from token balances
integration_tips: Use balanceOf/transfer/approve as standard ERC-20 but expect uint96 limits on amounts
Call delegate or delegateBySig to participate in governance voting
Query getPriorVotes for snapshot-based governance rather than current balance
permit supports rawAmount == uint(-1) for infinite allowance

explainer.summary: LinkToken implements an ERC20-compatible token with ERC677 extensions, minting the entire 10**27 supply to the deployer in the constructor. It inherits SafeMath, StandardToken, and ERC677Token, adding a validRecipient modifier to transfers, transferFrom, approve, and transferAndCall that blocks the zero address and the token contract itself. No owner, pauser, or other privileged roles are present in the source.

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: Moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after validRecipient check, using SafeMath.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens from _from to _to using allowance, after validRecipient check.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowance for _spender after validRecipient check.

key_functions.name: transferAndCall
key_functions.what: Calls super.transfer then Transfer event with data and onTokenTransfer if recipient is a contract, after validRecipient.

key_functions.name: increaseApproval
key_functions.what: Adds to allowance and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: decreaseApproval
key_functions.what: Subtracts from allowance (or sets to zero) and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: balanceOf
key_functions.what: Returns balances[_owner].

key_functions.name: allowance
key_functions.what: Returns allowed[_owner][_spender].

explainer.upgradeability: None present; contract has no proxy, owner, or upgrade logic.
user_risks: approve still permits the classic race condition if not using increaseApproval/decreaseApproval.
transferAndCall will silently succeed even if onTokenTransfer reverts inside the receiver (no try/catch in 0.4.16).
integration_tips: Call transferAndCall when sending to a contract that implements ERC677Receiver to trigger onTokenTransfer.
Use increaseApproval/decreaseApproval instead of approve to avoid front-running issues.
All transfers reject the zero address and the token contract itself via validRecipient.

explainer.summary: GnosisSafe v1.3.0 is a multisig wallet singleton (contracts/GnosisSafe.sol) that initializes via setup() and executes transactions only after checkNSignatures() validates the required owner threshold using EIP-712 encoded data. The constructor sets threshold=1 to prevent direct use, and all state changes (owners, modules, fallback, guard) are restricted to authorized calls or setup. Execution uses Executor.execute() for Call/DelegateCall and always handles payment via handlePayment() even on failure.

key_functions.name: setup
key_functions.what: Initializes owners via setupOwners, fallbackHandler via internalSetFallbackHandler, modules via setupModules, and optional payment; emits SafeSetup.

key_functions.name: execTransaction
key_functions.what: Encodes tx data, increments nonce, checks signatures, optionally runs guard checks, executes via execute(), pays gas via handlePayment, and emits success/failure.

key_functions.name: checkNSignatures
key_functions.what: Validates exactly requiredSignatures from the packed signatures bytes using ecrecover, approvedHashes, or contract isValidSignature; enforces ordering and bounds.

key_functions.name: handlePayment
key_functions.what: Calculates and transfers gasUsed+baseGas * gasPrice (capped to tx.gasprice for ETH) to refundReceiver or tx.origin using send or transferToken.

key_functions.name: approveHash
key_functions.what: Marks a hash in approvedHashes[msg.sender] after confirming msg.sender is an owner; emits ApproveHash.

key_functions.name: encodeTransactionData
key_functions.what: Returns the EIP-712 prefixed bytes for a SafeTx using SAFE_TX_TYPEHASH, domainSeparator, and all tx parameters including nonce.

key_functions.name: setGuard
key_functions.what: Stores guard address in GUARD_STORAGE_SLOT when called via authorized modifier (self-call only).

key_functions.name: setFallbackHandler
key_functions.what: Stores handler in FALLBACK_HANDLER_STORAGE_SLOT when called via authorized modifier; emits ChangedFallbackHandler.

admin_powers: setupOwners and setupModules (called only from setup)
explainer.upgradeability: Singleton contract deployed at 0xd9Db270c1B5E3Bd161E8c8503c55cEABeE709552; constructor locks threshold=1 so it can only be used via proxy; no upgrade logic present in GnosisSafe.sol.
user_risks: GS010/GS013/GS011/GS012/GS020-GS026 reverts on insufficient gas, failed payment, or invalid signatures
DelegateCall operation can change arbitrary storage
Guard and fallbackHandler execute external code before/after tx
nonce and approvedHashes are public and can be pre-approved
integration_tips: Always use encodeTransactionData or getTransactionHash for off-chain signing
Provide at least safeTxGas+2500+500 gas when calling execTransaction
Use StorageAccessible for post-deployment estimates instead of requiredTxGas
Check getGuard() and fallback handler before relying on hooks

explainer.summary: Multicall3 aggregates results from multiple function calls in a single transaction using structs Call, Call3, Call3Value and Result. It provides backwards compatibility with previous Multicall versions through functions like aggregate, tryAggregate, blockAndAggregate and tryBlockAndAggregate as defined in the source. The contract contains no state variables, constructor or owner and exposes only the listed public and view functions.

key_functions.name: aggregate
key_functions.what: Backwards-compatible call aggregation with Multicall that requires all calls to succeed and returns blockNumber and returnData.

key_functions.name: tryAggregate
key_functions.what: Backwards-compatible with Multicall2; aggregates calls and returns Result[] allowing optional failure based on requireSuccess flag.

key_functions.name: tryBlockAndAggregate
key_functions.what: Backwards-compatible with Multicall2; calls tryAggregate and additionally returns blockNumber and blockHash.

key_functions.name: blockAndAggregate
key_functions.what: Calls tryBlockAndAggregate with requireSuccess=true and returns blockNumber, blockHash and Result[].

key_functions.name: aggregate3
key_functions.what: Aggregates Call3 structs, reverts on failure unless allowFailure is true, using inline assembly for the revert check.

key_functions.name: aggregate3Value
key_functions.what: Aggregates Call3Value structs with per-call value, accumulates valAccumulator, requires msg.value equals the sum, and reverts on disallowed failures.

key_functions.name: getBlockHash
key_functions.what: Returns blockhash for a given blockNumber.

key_functions.name: getEthBalance
key_functions.what: Returns the ETH balance of a given address using addr.balance.

key_functions.name: getChainId
key_functions.what: Returns block.chainid.

explainer.upgradeability: No upgrade mechanism, proxy pattern, or state-changing admin functions exist in the source; the contract is a standalone non-upgradeable implementation.
user_risks: aggregate and blockAndAggregate revert on any call failure via require(success, ...)
aggregate3Value reverts if msg.value does not equal the sum of call values
External calls execute with the Multicall3 contract as msg.sender and may perform arbitrary actions
integration_tips: Use aggregate3 or aggregate3Value for per-call allowFailure control instead of older tryAggregate variants
Declare calls payable to save 24 gas per call as noted in the contract comments
Call view helpers such as getBlockNumber or getChainId directly for on-chain context without aggregation overhead

explainer.summary: ENSRegistryWithFallback extends ENSRegistry and stores a reference to an older ENS contract in the immutable 'old' field set at construction. For any node where recordExists returns false it delegates owner/resolver/ttl queries to the old contract; all mutations go through the inherited authorised modifier and Record storage. The only constructor argument is the prior ENS instance and the sole deviation from ENSRegistry is the _setOwner override that maps a zero owner to address(this).

key_functions.name: constructor
key_functions.what: Stores the provided ENS instance in the public 'old' variable after calling the ENSRegistry constructor.

key_functions.name: resolver
key_functions.what: Returns old.resolver(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise the value from super.resolver(node).

key_functions.name: owner
key_functions.what: Returns old.owner(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise the value from super.owner(node); super.owner maps address(this) to address(0).

key_functions.name: ttl
key_functions.what: Returns old.ttl(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise the value from super.ttl(node).

key_functions.name: setOwner
key_functions.what: Authorised caller may call _setOwner which stores the owner (mapping zero to address(this)) and emits Transfer.

key_functions.name: setSubnodeOwner
key_functions.what: Authorised caller computes subnode = keccak256(node,label), stores its owner via _setOwner and emits NewOwner.

key_functions.name: setApprovalForAll
key_functions.what: Allows any address to grant or revoke an operator that can act on all of its nodes.

admin_powers: The address supplied to the ENSRegistry constructor becomes owner of the root node 0x0 and can therefore call any authorised function on it.
explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; the contract is immutable after deployment and only provides read-only fallback to a separately deployed older ENS instance via the 'old' storage variable.
user_risks: Any node whose owner is never set in this registry will continue to be controlled by whatever state exists in the old ENS contract.
If the old ENS contract is compromised or its data is altered, queries for unset nodes will reflect that state.
integration_tips: Call recordExists before relying on owner/resolver/ttl to know whether data is coming from the old registry.
When transferring ownership to address(0) the registry will internally store address(this) instead, preventing the node from disappearing.

explainer.summary: Seaport 1.5 (contracts/Seaport.sol) is a thin wrapper inheriting from Consideration that sets the contract name via assembly in _name and _nameString; its constructor accepts a conduitController address and passes it to the parent. No public functions are defined in the provided Seaport source; all execution logic resides in inherited contracts such as Executor.

key_functions.name: constructor
key_functions.what: Accepts conduitController address and forwards it to Consideration constructor.

key_functions.name: _name

explainer.summary: Lido.sol implements the core liquid staking pool as an AragonApp (v2 after finalizeUpgrade_v2), accepting ETH via submit/fallback, tracking buffered/CL balances via unstructured storage slots, and processing oracle reports via handleOracleReport to rebase shares and finalize withdrawals. explainer.summary: CryptoPunksMarket is a Solidity 0.4.8 contract that mints and manages 10000 unique punks via owner-controlled initial assignment followed by user get/transfer/offer/bid mechanics. Ownership is tracked in punkIndexToAddress and balanceOf mappings; sales use Offer structs and bids use Bid structs with pendingWithdrawals for payouts. All state-changing functions after deployment require allPunksAssigned==true except the three owner-only initial-assignment functions.

key_functions.what: Constructor sets owner, totalSupply=10000, punksRemainingToAssign=10000, name, symbol and decimals.

key_functions.what: Owner-only function that sets allPunksAssigned=true, enabling getPunk and trading.

key_functions.what: Claims an unassigned punkIndex for msg.sender once allPunksAssigned is true and punks remain.

key_functions.name: transferPunk
key_functions.what: Transfers punk ownership, cancels any active offer, refunds a bid if the recipient had placed one.

key_functions.what: Lists a punk for sale at minValue with no buyer restriction.

key_functions.what: Purchases an offered punk if value meets minValue and seller still owns it; funds go to pendingWithdrawals.

key_functions.what: Places or replaces a bid; refunds the previous highest bid via pendingWithdrawals.

key_functions.what: Seller accepts the current bid if it meets minPrice; transfers ownership and records payment.
